reader_mode.authority: bounded server-owned browser-session plus opaque tab ID plus exact-locale state
reader_mode.retention: enabled for subsequent same-locale questions until one explicit disable

http.set: POST /api/documentation-assistant/web-mode with the same opaque tab_id
http.mutation_security: same-origin JSON guard and opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Strict assistant session

reader_mode.tab_isolation: The tab ID groups server state but grants no authority; a separate tab starts off and cannot change another tab's mode record.

required: server mode enabled for the owning session and exact locale
deterministic BPM scope allow before local or external retrieval
current same-locale answer-ready local BPM evidence
second deterministic scope check immediately before provider admission
one fixed Brave LLM Context POST

evidence_and_answer.local_authority: Current BPM documentation is required and remains first and higher priority.
evidence_and_answer.external_sources: Only the reviewed fixed Mozilla host/path allowlist; result URLs are metadata and are never fetched.
evidence_and_answer.external_content: sanitized untrusted request-local data in bounded leases
evidence_and_answer.conflict: abstain rather than let external evidence override BPM documentation
evidence_and_answer.model_output: validated local_text/local citations plus separately structured external_claims/external citations
evidence_and_answer.conversation_retention: only the locally grounded answer and local citations enter multi-turn context
evidence_and_answer.stream: local final-event schema remains unchanged when there are no external claims; web answers add a separate external_claims collection with opaque source handles
evidence_and_answer.source_resolution: external handles expose only allowlisted URL, title, locale, provider ID and external source kind

local_answer_preserved_for: empty, stale or over-budget external evidence
fallback.cancellation: terminates the request without a late answer

no_call_events: crafted request while server mode is off
